sentence: This project designs a plan for improving and expanding instruction in cybersecurity and computer science.
This project develops methods that reduce bias in machine learning used for smart mobility.
This project develops a course of study on two-dimensional quantum materials and devices.
This project builds a system that uses computer vision and machine learning to identify parts and measure them automatically on a coordinate measuring machine.
This project uses preserved plants, animals and fossils in biological collections, linked with genetic and environmental information, to study how biodiversity and environments change.
This project tries to speed up a printing process that hardens liquid resin with light by injecting resin through the part.
This project tries to find out when millet, wheat and barley spread across regions and how ancient farmers cooked and irrigated them.
This project uses a mass spectrometer to measure small molecules, peptides and proteins in street drug samples, natural plants and water.
This project combines brain imaging with human motion data to study how visual hallucinations relate to movement in Parkinson's disease.
This project develops ways to find and reduce risks when people use large language models in healthcare.
This project tests a prototype that uses embedded computers to collect data from field devices and cybersecurity algorithms to remove malicious data.
This project studies how nutrients move from land to freshwater lakes and how conservation practices affect harmful algal blooms.
This project brings together scientists to share work on how animals survive extreme conditions such as deep oceans, desert heat and winter hibernation.
This project builds a fast computer tool that simulates how sensory membrane proteins move, and tests it against hydrogen-deuterium exchange data.
This project develops methods to place geospatial data at accurate positions and to check its quality.
